SELECT complete.project_id AS id, project.short_name AS name, complete.project_id As projectId, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct complete.spot_check_user_name) AS spotCheckUserNames, sum(complete.qualified_quantity) AS qualifiedQuantity, sum(complete.un_qualified_quantity) AS unQualifiedQuantity FROM mes_building_spot_check_qhse complete LEFT JOIN contract_project project on project.id = complete.project_id where complete.bool_delete_enum = 0 and complete.task_type_enum = 2
and complete.project_id = #{projectId}
and project.name like CONCAT('%', #{projectName},'%')
and complete.spot_check_user_name like CONCAT('%', #{userName},'%')
GROUP BY complete.project_id

SELECT complete.project_id AS projectId, complete.monomer_id AS id, monomer.name AS name, GROUP_CONCAT(complete.spot_check_user_name) AS spotCheckUserName, sum(complete.qualified_quantity) AS qualifiedQuantity, sum(complete.un_qualified_quantity) AS unQualifiedQuantity FROM mes_building_spot_check_qhse complete LEFT JOIN plan_monomer monomer on monomer.id = complete.monomer_id where complete.bool_delete_enum = 0 and complete.task_type_enum = 2
and complete.project_id in
#{projectId}
and complete.spot_check_user_name like CONCAT('%', #{userName},'%')
GROUP BY complete.monomer_id,complete.project_id

SELECT project.short_name AS 'project.shortName', project.name AS 'project.name', project.serial_number AS 'project.serialNumber', monomer.name AS 'monomer.name', complete.serial_number, complete.name, complete.specification, sum(complete.qualified_quantity) AS qualifiedQuantity, sum(complete.un_qualified_quantity) AS unQualifiedQuantity, complete.spot_check_remark, complete.spot_check_user_name, complete.spot_check_day_date AS spotCheckDate, complete.spot_check_day_date AS spotCheckDateTime FROM mes_building_spot_check_qhse complete LEFT JOIN contract_project project on project.id = complete.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer monomer on monomer.id = complete.monomer_id where complete.bool_delete_enum = 0 and complete.task_type_enum = 2 and complete.project_id = #{projectId}
and monomer.id = #{monomerId}
and complete.spot_check_user_name like CONCAT('%', #{userName},'%')
and monomer.name like CONCAT('%', #{monomerName},'%')
and complete.name like CONCAT('%', #{name},'%')
and complete.serial_number like CONCAT('%', #{serialNumber},'%')
and complete.specification like CONCAT('%', #{specification},'%')
GROUP BY complete.serial_number, complete.NAME, complete.specification,complete.product_id,project.id,monomer.id ,complete.spot_check_user_name,complete.spot_check_day_date,complete.spot_check_remark
